result.title: Efficient Memory-Constrained Video Object Segmentation via Subspace Optimization
result.summary: Memory-based architectures for video object segmentation (VOS) have achieved remarkable performance by maintaining dense feature representations from past frames in a streaming Memory Bank. However, storing these features over time incurs substantial memory overhead and computational cost. In this work, we identify significant temporal redundancy in memory representations, where consecutive frames exhibit highly overlapping low-rank subspaces that remain stable over time. Building on this observation, we propose Memory Subspace Iteration (MSI), a training-free, model-agnostic plugin that exploits temporal subspace stability to efficiently compress streaming memory features. Extensive experiments on standard VOS benchmarks demonstrate that MSI preserves segmentation accuracy across multiple architectures while reducing the memory bank footprint by up to 25%. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Hai-Anh-LE/MSI_WACV2027.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对基于记忆库的视频目标分割，发现连续帧记忆特征存在稳定的低维子空间冗余，提出免训练、模型无关的 MSI 插件，用子空间迭代压缩流式记忆特征，在多种架构上减少约 25% 记忆占用并保持分割精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉记忆特征低秩子空间随时间去冗余」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中跨步视觉证据缓存的压缩与视觉细节保留之间的权衡，但原文面向分割而非推理，是否适用需进一步判断。
